limitations: Task callbacks are decoded but never invoked.
Per-tick progress, completion, mission linkage and full task destructor ownership are not decoded.
WORD+28 contains a second unresolved byte; do not equate word==0 with the complete active predicate.
A live reader must re-resolve both current pair indexes and the same current object, then check header/endpoints; never follow a cached old task pointer.
Typed indexed task is an in-progress signal, not annexation completion or exclusive request causality.
